title: HireAI Candidate Scoring Feature Schema
description: Preliminary feature schema definition for Member 3 candidate scoring model design. Note: These are proposed features designed for candidate evaluation and are not yet fully integrated into the live backend.

resume_features.description: Features derived from the candidate's parsed resume documenting past background, academic record, and stated qualifications.

skills_relevance.description: Relevance and depth of candidate's stated skill profile relative to occupational expectations.

relevant_experience.description: Directly applicable domain experience normalized against target seniority benchmarks.

education_relevance.description: Alignment of candidate's academic credentials, degree level, and discipline to role expectations.

job_matching_features.description: Features comparing candidate profile specifics against the target job description requirements and vacancy criteria.

required_skills_matched.description: Ratio of mandatory/core required skills specified in the job description that the candidate explicitly demonstrates.

missing_required_skills.description: Count or normalized ratio of missing mandatory skills identified in the gap analysis.

overall_jd_relevance.description: Semantic relevance score between candidate profile text and full job description text (e.g. dense bi-encoder cosine similarity).

interview_features.description: Features extracted from technical and behavioral interview transcript analysis and evaluation.

answer_relevance.description: Semantic accuracy and contextual correctness of candidate answers to structured interview questions.

communication_assessment.description: Evaluated clarity, structure, conciseness, and articulation of responses during interview rounds.
